rationale: The entry premise relied on the $30.00 psychological level and the 5-minute 9-EMA acting as resistance, combined with downward follow-through near the session lows. Instead, ZIM found support at $29.88 and recently pushed back above both the 5-minute 9-EMA ($29.99) and the $30.00 level on expanding 1-minute buying volume (10.9k shares). Because the immediate breakdown failed to materialize and key short-term resistance levels have been reclaimed, exiting now cuts the loss early rather than waiting for a test of the $30.15 invalidation level.
